supersedes.repair_reason: R0 dominant-mechanism labels exceeded what one observational capture can identify and did not close dependence, missingness, metric-selection or competing-person-motion guards.

predecessor_gate.structural_constraint: Internal raw-risk, trend or score differences do not count as progress when level, proximity, event and accepted feedback remain unchanged.

question: Within the already burned single REveL Dynamic capture, which one controlled follow-up experiment, if any, is sufficiently prioritized by robust event-level error-burden enrichment: an ego-motion compensation canary or a new-data temporal-trend canary?
non_goals: change, patch or rerun either LITE R2 arm
select a threshold, window or routing metric after output access
produce an effectiveness, generalization, confirmation, product or safety conclusion
treat frames, frame pairs, tracks, parent events or overlap components as population-independent samples
open the old F-1B decision output
open or use the production temporal A/B trace as a D0 input
download or execute EVIMO2v2, JRDB or a Confirmation source
forbidden_inputs: old F-1B decision output or any derivative
R0 or R1 failed LITE candidate output as scientific evidence
new REveL clips, events, labels or identities

data_join_contract.evaluation_arm_id_source: Inject arm_id from the parent arm_summaries object key; an event row does not contain arm_id.
evaluation_checks: event_id is unique within each arm and both arm keysets exactly equal the 469 primary natural-event keyset
target_id, anchor_region and truth_state exactly equal the natural event
coverage exactly equals non_abstained_rows divided by denominator_rows under the frozen numeric representation
data_join_contract.natural_event_membership: truth.event_id exact joins one of the 469 primary natural events
natural_truth_membership_checks: member source_frame_index values are consecutive from natural_event.start_source_frame_index through end_source_frame_index
the first and last member source_frame_index and bag_image_timestamp_ns exactly equal the natural-event frame and timestamp endpoints
capture_id, target_id, truth_state, event_id and event_anchor_region exactly equal the natural event

source_motion_derivation.nearest_sensor_index: For a person endpoint time, right=searchsorted(sensor_t,person_t,side='left'); clip left=right-1 and right to valid bounds; choose left when abs(person_t-sensor_t[left]) <= abs(sensor_t[right]-person_t), otherwise right.

sensor_pair_selection.pair: Apply nearest_sensor_index independently at both person endpoints.
sensor_pair_selection.adjacent_index: index_delta == 1 is allowed only when the sensor interval itself passes the same continuity rules.

range_geometry.sensor_absolute_share: abs(sensor_approach_component_mps) / (abs(sensor_approach_component_mps) + abs(person_approach_component_mps)); denominator below 1e-6 m/s yields null

source_motion_derivation.closure_check: Every common valid row must match the frozen signed approach rate within absolute 1e-6 m/s and preserve its deadband state; any mismatch invalidates execution and emits no priority exit.

camera_motion.angular_speed_radps: Normalize quaternions, flip q1 when dot(q0,q1)<0, apply shortest SO(3) logarithm and divide magnitude by dt_s.

event_source_support.null_rule: If either gate fails, all source-component event summaries are null and the event remains in every fixed denominator.

sensor_absolute_share_event_support.finite_share_count: count of pair rows with finite sensor_absolute_share
sensor_absolute_share_event_support.null_rule: If either gate fails, event-level sensor_absolute_share is null while other valid source-component summaries remain unchanged.

event_source_aggregation.median_person_approach_component_mps: median of finite pair-level signed person_approach_component_mps
event_source_aggregation.median_sensor_approach_component_mps: median of finite pair-level signed sensor_approach_component_mps
event_source_aggregation.sensor_absolute_share: median of finite pair-level sensor_absolute_share values
event_source_aggregation.median_camera_translation_speed_mps: type-7 median of finite pair-level camera translation speeds
event_source_aggregation.p90_camera_translation_speed_mps: type-7 q=0.90 of finite pair-level camera translation speeds
event_source_aggregation.median_camera_angular_speed_radps: type-7 median of finite pair-level camera angular speeds
event_source_aggregation.p90_camera_angular_speed_radps: type-7 q=0.90 of finite pair-level camera angular speeds
event_source_aggregation.source_gate_failure: Every source-component and camera-motion event summary is null with explicit missing reasons.

roi_and_temporal_derivation.target_order: Use frozen replay file order and independently require source_frame_index to be strictly increasing within each target.
roi_and_temporal_derivation.pair_order: Use the immediate previous replay row within target order; it may cross a natural-event boundary but must have the same track_epoch and the current row must have history_reset=false.
roi_pair_valid_when: BBOX_LOG_AREA_GROWTH abstention_reason is null and signed_approach_rate_per_s is finite
shape-change rows remain invalid exactly as in LITE R2
roi_and_temporal_derivation.bbox_rate_closure: abs(recomputed_signed_log_area_rate_per_s - frozen_BBOX_signed_approach_rate_per_s) <= 1e-12 for every finite BBOX row; any mismatch invalidates execution.
roi_and_temporal_derivation.finite_flow_row: ROI_SPARSE_RADIAL_FLOW abstention_reason is null and signed_approach_rate_per_s is finite.
roi_and_temporal_derivation.event_row_order: Natural-event members in strictly increasing source_frame_index order.
roi_and_temporal_derivation.flow_sign_flip_fraction: Map finite_flow_row signed rate through the frozen 0.02/s deadband to -1,0,+1. Count changes only between adjacent source_frame_index rows; abstained or nonfinite rows break the chain. Zero eligible transitions yields null.

temporal_event_support.quality_component_row: A row is eligible for a named quality summary when that quality.components field exists and is finite, whether or not the flow row abstained. This preserves low-support evidence instead of conditioning it away.
temporal_event_support.median_flow_score_mad_per_s: median of all finite quality.components.score_mad_per_s values under quality_component_row
temporal_event_support.median_surviving_tracks: median of all finite quality.components.surviving_tracks values under quality_component_row
temporal_event_support.minimum_surviving_tracks: minimum of all finite quality.components.surviving_tracks values under the same inclusion rule
temporal_event_support.other_quality_summaries: Each named detected_features, occupied_quadrants, forward_backward_error_px or score_mad field uses all rows where that individual component exists and is finite, and reports its own finite count, coverage and missing reasons.
temporal_event_support.null_rule: If either preselected temporal metric fails its 3-row or 50% event support gate, both preselected temporal event summaries are null and the event remains in every fixed denominator.

summary_math.quantile_definition: Hyndman-Fan type 7, equivalent to NumPy method='linear'
summary_math.mad: raw median absolute deviation around the named median; no 1.4826 scaling
summary_math.cliff_delta: P(burden_WRONG_SIGNED > burden_CORRECT) - P(burden_WRONG_SIGNED < burden_CORRECT); exact ties contribute zero

dependence_contract.overlap_definition: Closed [start_timestamp_ns,end_timestamp_ns] intervals; transitive connected components across both targets.

component_balanced_cliff.finite_component_count: K_g is the number of distinct components in group g with at least one finite event metric value.
component_balanced_cliff.event_weight: w(i,g)=1/(K_g*n(component_i,g)), where n(component_i,g) is the finite event count for that metric, group and component.
component_balanced_cliff.delta: sum_i sum_j w(i,WRONG_SIGNED)*w(j,CORRECT)*sign(x_i-x_j); each group's weights sum exactly to one.

time_block.candidate_block_rule: A fixed block is a candidate when both WRONG_SIGNED and CORRECT have total_n >= 8 before metric missingness.
time_block.block_missingness_failure: If any candidate block fails its finite-n, finite-fraction or group-difference gate, the preselected metric is not globally route-evaluable; the block cannot be omitted.

block_balanced_cliff.block_set: B is the fixed set of candidate blocks after every candidate block passes the finite-support gates.
block_balanced_cliff.event_weight: w(i,g)=1/(abs(B)*n(block_i,g)), where n(block_i,g) is the finite event count for that metric, group and block.
block_balanced_cliff.delta: sum_i sum_j w(i,WRONG_SIGNED)*w(j,CORRECT)*sign(x_i-x_j); each group's weights sum exactly to one.

time_block.per_block_sensitivity: Report each common block's ordinary finite-event Cliff delta; any delta <= -0.33 is a material contradiction.

missingness_contract.scope: Apply separately to every preselected metric across the pooled event view, both target marginals, every region with fixed total_n >= 8 in both groups, approaching and receding truth-state marginals, the component view and every candidate fixed block.

component_missingness.total_occupied_components_g: Number of distinct components containing at least one fixed-denominator event from group g before metric missingness.
component_missingness.finite_components_g: Number of those occupied components containing at least one finite metric value from group g.

missingness_contract.required_region_rule: Every anchor region with fixed total_n >= 8 in both groups is required to pass finite support; at least two such regions must exist.
missingness_contract.block_candidate_rule: Every block with total_n >= 8 in both groups is required. A finite-support failure makes the metric globally not route-evaluable and cannot silently remove that block.
missingness_contract.null_event_handling: Retain the event in fixed denominators and missingness tables; omit only its metric value.
missingness_contract.support_failure_effect: The metric cannot support a priority exit; fixed denominators are unchanged.

error_partition.classification_binding: Reuse exact frozen R2 event predicted_state, correct, wrong_signed and 0.02/s deadband without reclassification.

required: both target marginal event-weighted Cliff deltas are strictly > 0
at least two evaluable anchor-region marginal Cliff deltas are strictly > 0
no evaluable anchor-region marginal Cliff delta <= -0.33
at least four common 60-second blocks are evaluable and none has Cliff delta <= -0.33

person_competing_rule.equal_or_larger: person event-weighted delta >= ego event-weighted delta OR person component-balanced delta >= ego component-balanced delta

contradictory_when: any required target, region, truth-state, component-balanced, block-balanced or common-block view for a proposed supporting metric has delta <= -0.33
pooled support is created by truth-state mixture while approaching or receding fails
a required missingness or dependence view is not evaluable

routing_booleans.global_route_evaluable: ego_share_gate is evaluable AND ego_primary, person_competing_primary, temporal_direct_primary and temporal_support_primary have every required pooled, target, required-region, truth-state, component and candidate-block view evaluable
routing_booleans.ego_candidate: global_route_evaluable AND ego_share_gate_value AND robust_support(ego_primary) AND NOT person_competing AND NOT ego_contradictory
routing_booleans.temporal_candidate: global_route_evaluable AND robust_support(temporal_direct_primary) AND robust_support(temporal_support_primary) AND NOT temporal_contradictory

scientific_exit_rule.EGO_CANARY_PRIORITY: execution_valid AND global_route_evaluable AND ego_candidate AND NOT temporal_candidate
scientific_exit_rule.TEMPORAL_TREND_PRIORITY: execution_valid AND global_route_evaluable AND temporal_candidate AND NOT ego_candidate
scientific_exit_rule.NO_PRIORITY_IDENTIFIED: execution_valid AND (NOT global_route_evaluable OR ego_candidate == temporal_candidate)
scientific_exit_rule.metric_or_required_view_not_evaluable: When execution_valid is true, emit NO_PRIORITY_IDENTIFIED.
scientific_exit_rule.execution_invalid: Identity, hash, join, closure, serialization or independent-validator failure emits no scientific exit.

event_table_contract.null_semantics: Explicit null with named missing reasons; never impute.

canonical_serialization.event_table_row_order: event_id lexical order, exactly equal to dependency receipt event_bindings order
canonical_serialization.jsonl_format: one compact object per line plus final LF
canonical_serialization.nonfinite_numbers: FORBIDDEN; use null plus explicit missing reason
canonical_serialization.analysis_metric_and_subgroup_order: exact protocol preselected-metric order followed by listed diagnostic-only order; targets, regions, truth states, components and blocks use frozen lexical or numeric order

independent_validator_contract.allowed_shared_code: Contract schema and literal constants only; no producer, analysis, aggregation or routing calculation functions.
must_recompute: dependency receipt semantics, canonical event bindings, 159 overlap pairs, 310 components, component size counts and six fixed blocks
all input hashes, row counts, keysets and joins
Vicon pair selection, source components, camera motion, ROI closure, flow and quality event fields
missingness tables, event, component-balanced and block-balanced Cliff deltas, all required marginals and block sensitivities
person competing rule, global_route_evaluable, contradiction booleans, candidates and unique exit
independent_validator_contract.comparison: Semantic exact comparison for identities, integers, strings, booleans, nulls, keysets and ordering. Recomputed source closure uses 1e-6 m/s; BBOX closure uses 1e-12/s; all other finite emitted floats must match the independently recomputed IEEE result exactly after canonical JSON round-trip.
must_verify: event_table and analysis hashes and canonical serialization

activation_preconditions: all frozen input and implementation hashes match
all already-burned JSON inputs, including R2 evaluation, may be parsed for row, keyset, join and frozen-classification checks
predecessor eligibility bindings match without opening production trace
old F-1B and Confirmation paths are not opened
one_shot_execution_contract.prestart_access_boundary: Prestart may hash and parse all explicitly frozen JSON inputs but may not open Vicon bag messages, derive a source component, compute any D0 pair/event metric or access a forbidden input.
one_shot_execution_contract.formal_start_creation: Exclusive create and fsync formal_start.json after all prestart bindings, row counts, keysets, joins and frozen classifications pass and before opening any Vicon bag message or computing any D0 pair/event metric.
one_shot_execution_contract.publication: Write and fsync same-volume temporary files, then atomically rename. failure_receipt.json and execution_receipt.json are mutually exclusive; formal_start.json is retained in both paths.
one_shot_execution_contract.valid_receipt_publication: Only after independent validator PASS, exclusively publish execution_validation.json and execution_receipt.json with status VALID and the unique priority exit.

EGO_CANARY_PRIORITY.single_change: Estimate one robust background affine transform outside the target mask or ROI, then compute target-internal residual radial expansion.

TEMPORAL_TREND_PRIORITY.reachability_requirement: Synthetic boundary fixtures must prove that the proposed temporal contribution changes at least one downstream decision state without changing thresholds, cooldown, fatigue or feedback policy.

claim_ceiling: BURNED_SINGLE_CAPTURE_OPERATIONAL_CANARY_PRIORITY_ONLY; NO CAUSAL DOMINANCE, EFFECTIVENESS, GENERALIZATION, CONFIRMATION, PRODUCT OR SAFETY CLAIM
